{%- comment -%}
  llmstxt.org: an H1, a blockquote summary, then H2 sections of `- [name](url): note`. The sections
  and their order are the nav panel's (`_config.yml` `sections`), and each link is the page's
  markdown twin, so a client following this file reads documents and never the shell around them.
{%- endcomment -%}
# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description | strip_newlines | strip }}

The product itself is at {{ site.app_url }}, and its own index at {{ site.app_url }}/llms.txt.
{%- assign docs = site.docs | where_exp: "doc", "doc.draft != true" | sort: "order" -%}
{%- for section in site.sections %}
{%- assign pages = docs | where: "section", section.id %}
{%- if pages.size > 0 %}

## {{ section.label }}
{% for doc in pages %}
- [{{ doc.title }}]({{ doc.url | append: "index.md" | absolute_url }}): {{ doc.description | strip_newlines | strip }}
{%- endfor %}
{%- endif %}
{%- endfor %}
